leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a recursive function to traverse a binary tree
Apply the lowest common ancestor algorithm to find shared ancestors
Construct a binary tree data structure with parent-child relationships
Manipulate tree nodes to test various ancestor scenarios
Initialize test cases with different tree configurations
Integrate the LCA function into a complete program
Control the flow of recursive calls with base cases
Render the results of LCA calculations for verification
